paragraphs.text: Deborah "Deb" Thomas is a former CFO of Hasbro , who retired in 2022.
When she retired after 24 years at the company, Thomas was given at least one celebration card made in her image as a Planeswalker .
Because the card features a standard card back , and a regular holofoil stamp , instead of an acorn stamp, this is an Eternal-legal card according to the Tournament Rules .
